Pilot · Ethiopia

Leul Abate

Ethiopian Airlines Flight 9611996
Flight
Ethiopian Airlines Flight 961
Date
23 November 1996
Aircraft
Boeing 767-200ER
Location
Off Grande Comore, Comoros
Survivors
50 of 175 aboard

Hijackers forced the Boeing 767 to fly until it ran out of fuel. He ditched it in the sea off the Comoros. 50 of the 175 people aboard survived.

Who helped

  • Yonas Mekuria First officerWas beaten by the hijackers and thrown out of the cockpit, but he came back and helped the captain control the aircraft during the ditching.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Leslianne Shedd PassengerHelped fellow passengers, including an elderly woman, with their life vests and comforted those around her before the ditching; she died in the crash.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Mohamed Amin PassengerConfronted the hijackers and urged other passengers to stand up to them during the flight; he died in the ditching.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5 6

Source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ethiopian_Airlines_Flight_961 ↗
